title: MedEvoEval: Evaluating Continual Evolution of Doctor Agents through Simulated Clinical Episodes
abstract: arXiv:2606.28900v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Doctor agents are moving beyond single-turn answer generation toward evolving clinical decision systems that acquire evidence within episodes and reuse experience across episodes. Fixed-input medical QA and many interactive benchmarks provide limited support for evaluating how episode-level decisions interact with cross-episode experience. We introduce MedEvoEval, an executable longitudinal evaluation framework based on action-gated simulated outpatient episodes. Each case is converted into role-specific patient, examination, and manager views; evidence is revealed through valid actions, and structured traces link observations, actions, final outputs, scores, and optional experience write-back. Experiments show that these traces expose process costs hidden by final-answer scoring, characterize how MDT-style consultation reallocates resources, and support analyses of memory maturation, held-out transfer, update-stage response, and bac

translated_title: MedEvoEval：通过模拟临床就诊情节评估医生智能体的持续演化
translated_abstract: 医生智能体正在超越单轮答案生成，向能够在就诊情节内获取证据、并在情节之间复用经验的持续演化式临床决策系统发展。固定输入的医学问答和许多交互式基准在评估情节级决策与跨情节经验之间如何交互方面提供的支持有限。我们提出MedEvoEval，一个基于动作门控模拟门诊情节的可执行纵向评估框架。每个病例被转换为角色特定的患者、检查和管理者视图；证据通过有效动作逐步揭示，结构化轨迹将观察、动作、最终输出、评分以及可选的经验写回联系起来。实验表明，这些轨迹能够揭示被最终答案评分所掩盖的过程成本，刻画MDT式多学科会诊如何重新分配资源，并支持对记忆成熟、留出集迁移、更新阶段响应等能力的分析。
tldr: 该论文提出MedEvoEval，一个基于动作门控模拟门诊情节的可执行纵向评估框架，通过结构化行为轨迹系统评估医生智能体在情节内证据获取与跨情节经验复用中的持续演化能力。
en_tdlr: MedEvoEval is an executable longitudinal evaluation framework based on action-gated simulated clinical episodes that assesses the continual evolution of doctor agents through structured behavioral traces linking in-episode evidence acquisition and cross-episode experience reuse.
